Messages.Author: Raven
Messages.Body:
Hello,

If I have played Immortal Grapple during combat and my opponent canceled it with Charismatic Aura, can I play another Immortal Grapple?

Immortal Grapple
Combat
Grapple. Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. A vampire can play only one Immortal Grapple each round.

[pot]Strikes that are not hand strikes cannot be used this round (by either combatant).
[POT]As above, with 1 optional press. If another round of combat occurs, that round is at close range (skip the determine range step for that round).

Charismatic Aura
Combat
[aus][presence]Burn 1 blood to cancel the opposing minion's strike card (the minion chooses another strike) or grapple card as it is played, and its cost is not paid. A vampire can play only one Charismatic Aura at basic each round.
[AUS][PRESENCE]Strike: combat ends.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Raven wrote:
> If I have played Immortal Grapple during combat and my opponent canceled it with Charismatic Aura, can I play another Immortal Grapple?
>
No. The first one was played, even though it had no effect (because of being cancelled).

This card text on the second one that you're about to play: "A vampire may play only one Immortal Grapple each round." ... will then spot that an earlier one was played, and so prohibits itself from being played.

Messages.Author: Abrouse
Messages.Body: If I have played Immortal Grapple during combat, my opponent can play another Immortal Grapple in the same round of this combat?

Messages.Author: acbishop
Messages.Body:
> Abrouse wrote:
> If I have played Immortal Grapple during combat, my opponent can play another Immortal Grapple in the same round of this combat?
>
Yes, as it is a different vampire playing it.

The cardtext of immortal grapple only prevents vampire A to play more than one Immortal grapple but it doesn't prevent vampire B to play it

"A vampire can play only one Immortal Grapple each round."
